title: Recursion to Host Webinar Focused on Updated REC-4881 (FAP) Data from CGA-IGC on Tuesday, November 3
content: Recursion to Host Webinar Focused on Updated REC-4881 (FAP) Data from CGA-IGC on Tuesday, November 3 October 26, 2026 at 4:05 PM EDT PDF Version Webinar will include earnings updates and REC-4881 data as well as KOL and patient panels, presented live from CGA-IGC on Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 8:00 am ET / 6:00 am MT / 1:00 pm GMT Third quarter 2026 results will be released prior to the webinar, after the close of US markets on Monday, November 2, 2026 Salt Lake City, UT , Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Recursion (Nasdaq: RXRX), a leading clinical-stage company pioneering AI-enabled drug discovery and development decoding biology to radically improve lives, announced today it will provide business updates and report its third quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 2, 2026 , after the close of the financial markets, with live call from the Collaborative Group of the Americas on Inherited Gastrointestinal Cancer (CGA-IGC) Annual Meeting in Denver, Colorado on November 3, 2026 , at 8:00 AM ET / 6:00 AM MT / 1:00 PM GMT . In advance of an expected regulatory update for REC-4881 by the end of the year, the call will feature: A third quarter recap from Najat Khan , Ph.D., Chief Executive Officer and President of Recursion, including encouraging REC-1245 monotherapy data, as well as a presentation REC-4481 data from the Company’s CGA-IGC plenary presidential presentation. KOL panel moderated by Vicki Goodman , M.D. Chief Medical Officer of Recursion, providing contextualization of the data, including a natural history perspective and relevance to unmet need in FAP, from global FAP specialists Bryson Katona , M.D., Ph.D., Director of the GI Cancer Genetics Program, University of Pennsylvania Perelman School of Medicine , and TUPELO study investigator, as well as Evelien Dekker M.D ., Ph.D., Head of the Expert Clinic for Familial and Hereditary Polyposis and Colorectal Cancer, and Principal Investigator of the Natural History Registry study, Amsterdam University Medical Center . Discussion moderated by Vicki Goodman , M.D. featuring patient advocates sharing their experiences on living with FAP, a disease for which there are currently no approved pharmacotherapies. The company will broadcast the call from Recursion’s X , LinkedIn , and YouTube accounts. Investors, analysts, and the public will be able to ask questions of the company by submitting questions here: Question Form . About Recursion Recursion (NASDAQ: RXRX) is a leading clinical-stage company pioneering AI-enabled drug discovery and development decoding biology to radically improve lives. Recursion is advancing a portfolio of differentiated investigational medicines across its wholly owned and partnered pipeline in oncology, rare disease, neuroscience, immunology, and other therapeutic areas with significant unmet need. Enabling its mission is the Recursion OS, an AI-native, end-to-end drug discovery and development platform integrating biology, chemistry, and clinical development into a unified intelligence system. Powered by proprietary multimodal data, purpose-built AI models, and bilingual teams fluent in both science and AI, the Recursion OS is designed to translate complex science into medicines that matter — faster, better, and at scale — for patients who are waiting. Recursion's platform infrastructure is anchored in Salt Lake City, Utah and Milton Park , Oxfordshire , where its automated biology and chemistry laboratories generate proprietary data at industrial scale. Recursion also maintains offices in New York , Montréal , and London , three global hubs for talent and leadership at the intersection of AI and scientific innovation.
